title: Storm Drain Replacement in Progress
description:
City of San Diego employees are hard at work on the La Jolla Scenic Drive onramp along La Jolla Parkway. Erosion compromised the road's stability, prompting this emergency storm drain replacement project.  

The work includes repairing the eroded hillside, replacing storm drain structures, and replacing curbs and guard rails. 

This busy ramp should be fully reopened soon. Thanks to the hard-working crews in our Stormwater Department! 

#SanDiegoAtWork #ThinkBlue
